pyramiding_rule: Strictly prohibit adding to positions within 15 minutes of a prior entry or when existing floating profit is negative.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require a validated ATR volatility contraction check and zero Tier-1 macroeconomic news events within a +/- 15-minute window before execution.
profit_harvest_threshold: Instantly lock in trailing stop-loss to breakeven + commission at +$3.00 and execute scaling partial exits at +$10.00 to prevent profit evaporation.
